elena_cs: Quick weekly health check for Polaris — p95/p99 snapshot by route and streaming vs non-streaming. Sharing numbers + next steps.
ben_eng: Pulled from the perf dashboard (last 24h):
```
/v1/chat (non-stream)  p95=320ms  p99=740ms
/v1/chat (stream)      p95=190ms  p99=610ms
/v1/embed              p95=48ms   p99=150ms
/v1/rerank             p95=420ms  p99=980ms
```
ravi_sre: 5xx error rate has ticked up to 0.85% over 24h (baseline ~0.3%). Most 5xx tied to chat non-stream path.
polaris_ops: Users report occasional slow replies during peak bursts, timeouts around 700ms. Seeing retries from client.
elena_cs: Spend and usage: last 7d spend ~$12.3k, usage -8% w/w. No renewal risk right now but we should flag the tail latency.
ben_eng: Hypothesis: fallback to the smaller quantized variant in their dedicated pool under contention increases non-stream tail. Streaming path bypasses some fallback logic, hence lower p95.
ben_eng: Query used to compute tails: 
```
# PromQL (simplified)
quantile_over_time(0.95, request_duration_ms[1h]) by (route, streaming)
quantile_over_time(0.99, request_duration_ms[1h]) by (route, streaming)
```
elena_cs: Immediate asks: @ravi_sre can you triage 5xx spike and confirm if it's fallback-related? @ben_eng please validate fallback timing & model selection logic. Also want an enablement walk-through for Polaris on streaming benefits.
polaris_ops: Thurs 10am PT works for us for enablement. Please include guidance on batching and client retry windows.
ravi_sre: I'll run the SLO runbook, check pod logs and kernel OOMs, and post findings by EOD.
ben_eng: I'll instrument a short A/B (no-fallback) for a shard to confirm impact on p99. Expect preliminary numbers in ~4h.
elena_cs: Added notes: reduce client retry aggressiveness for now to avoid amplification; flag if spend jumps after A/B.
latency-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/polaris/latency?range=24h&split=streaming (auto-upload)
elena_cs: Thanks all — we'll capture action items in the enablement doc and follow up in next weekly. :thumbsup:
